sources.title: Qatari delegation arrives in Tehran for peace talks
Rubio urges G-20 cooperation amid rifts over wars in Ukraine, Middle East

en.title: Qatari Delegation Arrives in Tehran for Peace Talks
en.dek: A Qatari delegation led by a senior adviser to the prime minister arrived in Tehran on Friday to discuss bilateral relations and regional developments amid Middle East tensions.
facts: Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran on Friday, led by a senior adviser to Qatar’s prime minister.
Delegation discussed bilateral relations and regional developments.
Arrival amid rising fears of a return to hostilities in the Middle East war.
G20 ministerial meeting in Atlanta, Georgia, was held on Oct 30-31.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged G20 ministers to find areas of agreement amid wars in Ukraine and the Middle East.
body: The Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran on Friday, according to Iran's state news agency IRNA. The delegation was led by a senior adviser to Qatar’s prime minister. They came to discuss bilateral relations and regional developments. The arrival follows a string of visits by senior officials.
State media reported that the delegation arrived amid rising fears of a return to hostilities in the Middle East war. The talks are part of efforts to revive peace talks with the United States.

The G20 ministerial meeting in Atlanta, Georgia, was held on Oct 30-31, according to The Straits Times. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged G20 ministers to find areas of agreement amid wars in Ukraine and the Middle East. Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov’s participation caused rifts among G20 members. The meeting was expected to end without a joint declaration.

The G20 leaders summit will be held in Miami, Florida, from Dec 14-16, according to the same source. G20 members expressed concerns about economic challenges caused by the wars. The meeting was expected to hammer out a joint declaration for the leaders summit. The meeting was expected to end with a chair's statement.
en.context: Middle East tensions have risen, raising fears of renewed hostilities. Diplomats are seeking to revive peace talks with the United States. The G20 meeting in Atlanta highlighted global concerns over the wars.
en.imageCaption: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged his counterparts to find areas of agreement during the final ministerial meeting.
